props.title: Weathered Signpost
props.text:
WEST ROAD

Millbrook lies east, across the Brightwater.
Travellers welcome. Mind the wolves after dark.

props.title: Bridge Notice
props.text:
BRIGHTWATER BRIDGE

By order of the reeve: no toll this season.
The southern ford is shallow but slow going.

props.title: Village Notice Board
props.text:
MILLBROOK

The Lantern & Thistle serves supper at dusk.
Brother Odran asks that the old temple road be cleared.
